name: Class of '86: Killer Reunion
tagline: Big hair, bigger grudges. Somebody never got over high school.
description: Twenty years on, the class of '86 returns to the gym for a reunion. The prom queen, the jock, the nerd-turned-billionaire and the teacher who knew too much. When the former class president is found under the bleachers, old rivalries turn deadly.
artStyle: 1980s neon synthwave, VHS grain, bold magenta and cyan
